what_this_task_is: a data task: build and validate one look-prefix 112 px corpus from the privileged scripted collector; trains nothing, fits no world model, preregisters no control formulation
claim_scope: C-ACCEPT would say: this corpus was collected as designed, and the pinned frozen DINOv2 CLS reads the post-look apple position and the expert's first post-look command on its 190 train+val roots beyond its seed-0 random init; nothing about prediction, control or closed loop
control_lines: CEM abandoned at TASK-054, behaviour cloning stopped at TASK-057; both clauses hold; no control formulation preregistered or implied

predecessor.row_next: preregister the look-prefix 112 px corpus with this frozen encoder as the candidate image encoder
caveats_carried_forward: P-cls is not detectably different from raw pixels: P-cls - L-raw +0.068 cm [-0.010, 0.153]; no equivalence margin
both random-init floors met the bars on their own
one encoder, one input size, one floor seed; floor-seed variance not measured
does not identify whether pretraining data, width or input size caused the result
readability is not prediction: no world model or controller was tested

look_prefix.on: every root episode, before the collector policy; branches start after it

corpus_design.branch_start: first command of the policy's close phase (pre-grasp state); stop after lift
corpus_design.renderer_warm_up: the simulation's renderer renders once and discards the result before the reset
corpus_design.privileged_truth: label sidecars only (collector__, privileged__ groups); never model inputs, loss weights or selection filters

candidate_encoder.status: candidate only; the corpus stores pixels, never features; any world-model use needs its own preregistration

input_handling.frame: the corpus's stored uint8 [N,112,112,3] frame 8 (post-look), decoded from PNG
input_handling.resize: 224 x 224, torch.nn.functional.interpolate bicubic, align_corners=False, antialias=False, no crop
input_handling.position_embeddings: interpolated from 37 x 37 by transformers' own bicubic rule
input_handling.execution: CPU, float32, eager attention, eval(), no_grad, batches of 16; features cast to float64
input_handling.hf_image_processor: not used (its centre crop cuts the borders)

candidate_encoder.read_out_point_decisional: P-cls: CLS after the final LayerNorm (pooler_output), 384-d
candidate_encoder.consistency_with_task063: same module bytes, preprocessing and read-out points; the stored frame 8 must equal a fresh re-render of the post-look state through the simulation's own 112 px path (Q-render); PNG is lossless (TASK-061 P2 190/190)

splits.rule: whole-reset sessions; default_rng(64).shuffle(seeds); first 20 val, next 10 test, remaining 170 train; branches share their root's split
splits.test_never_decoded: test episodes are written once at assembly and never decoded afterwards; checked by sha256 only; decoding-based QA (A6-A8, A10, A11 loads, readability gate) reads train + val only; all-split facts are recorded at collection time
splits.later_use: train on train, select on val, never decode test during training or selection

plan.authoritative: the recorded plan.json of the run

acceptance_checks.source_of_thresholds: TASK-048's frozen values, unchanged; not tuned on the pilot

checks.A6: each right-arm dim 6-11: >= 3% of transitions > +0.1 and >= 3% < -0.1 (train + val)
checks.A8: sibling-branch pairs RGB-distinct at step 16 >= 90% (train + val)
checks.A9: no split leakage; normalisation = train; train/val/test nonempty
checks.A10: audit: every train + val episode decodes with 0.05 s intervals; every stored episode's collection-time intervals are 0.05 s
checks.A11: train + val sidecars load (hash, rows, look phase labels); test sidecars match sha256; privileged access without acknowledgement refused
checks.A13: all 200 roots completed without runtime error; every branched root restored exactly
checks.L1: look on every root at collection time: 8 commands executed, applied == requested exactly, post-look state spread <= 1e-6, apple xy and plate moves <= 1e-6 m after every look command, no hand-apple contact

descriptive_only: outcome tables by noise level, branch kind, split, failure stage

readability_gate.roots: the 190 train + val roots (170 train, 20 val) sorted by seed; test never read
readability_gate.frame: stored frame 8 of each root episode
readability_gate.targets: T1 reset apple xy; T2/T3 sign and value of the expert's right_dx at the post-look state (apple_collector_policy(reset truth) at the post-look pose)
fresh_rerender_gives: B-occ reset visibility flag (112 px segmentation)
readability_gate.readouts: linear and RBF kernel ridge, nested inner CV (info_ceiling), lambda 1e-4..1e4
readability_gate.folds: grouped 10-fold, default_rng(59), roots sorted by seed
readability_gate.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples, seed 5901; Wilson for T2
readability_gate.baselines: B-occ, B-maj, B-const computed in-run on these roots

bars.T1: median <= 1.5 cm and ratio-to-B-occ upper bound <= 0.6
bars.T2: accuracy >= 0.85 and Wilson lower bound > B-maj

pass_rule_P_cls.R1: succeeds on all 190 roots under the bars
pass_rule_P_cls.R2: beats R-cls (seed-0 random init, same read-out point): paired CI of median T1 difference below 0 and higher T2
pass_rule_P_cls.R3: p_arm = encoder_study.arm_pvalues <= 0.025 one-sided (one hypothesis, no Holm family)
pass_rule_P_cls.R4: not spurious: apple-hidden frames do not beat the prior on all roots; ablation renderer reproduces 190/190

stated_in_advance: a failure is a live possibility: these roots are not the ones the look was chosen on
a pass removes no TASK-063 caveat

guards_void_the_run.G-hash: every file in hashes matches before collection; clean tracked tree; src/**/*.py and tracked inputs unchanged at finalize
guards_void_the_run.G-plan: plan.json hashes to the pin (exact on macOS arm64, rounded everywhere) and is unchanged at finalize
guards_void_the_run.G-stop: supervisor cap not reached; every worker exits 0
guards_void_the_run.Q-split: exactly the planned 170 train + 20 val roots; any other id refused
guards_void_the_run.Q-render: stored frame 0 and frame 8 equal fresh re-renders; post-look re-render stable
guards_void_the_run.Q-expert: recomputed post-look expert == collector__base_action[8] within 1e-6 on non-aim roots; first 8 phase labels are the look; stored apple label == reset truth within 1e-6 m
guards_void_the_run.G-weights: TASK-063's pinned DINOv2 files and both digests
guards_void_the_run.not_guards: a root-level runtime error fails A13; a failed look fails L1; both are C-DATA-FAIL, not V; any other exception is a crash and V

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: a guard fails, or the run stops before writing a complete report
every acceptance check (A1-A13, L1) passes and the readability gate passes
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: a separately preregistered world-model task on apple-look-v1 with this frozen encoder as a candidate image encoder; no control formulation implied

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: the readability gate fails (whatever the acceptance checks say)
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: TASK-063's P-cls result does not replicate on fresh resets

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: the readability gate passes and at least one acceptance check fails
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: the corpus is not as designed; kept as evidence, not accepted, not repaired
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: any re-collection uses a new seed range and version, preregistered separately; no abandonment

inconclusive_task_level: a second V closes TASK-064 as INCONCLUSIVE; nothing is read; the abandonment clause does not fire

abandonment_clause.closes: the frozen-DINOv2 route to a look-prefix corpus: no world model is preregistered on this corpus with this encoder, and no further pretrained encoder, read-out point, input size or look variant is preregistered on this corpus without new evidence of a different kind
abandonment_clause.context_not_preregistered: the overview camera (TASK-061 O-raw 0.183 cm [0.168, 0.207], 185/190) is a hardware/workspace change; the owner's decision

void_rule.void: any early stop (guard, crash, cap) is V with a void_reason
void_rule.repeat: exactly one from-scratch repeat into data/apple-look-v1-run2 and data/apple-look-v1-run2-work, same seeds, caps, workers, device, clean tree
void_rule.fixes_between_runs: runner mechanics only, via a reviewed PR and a fresh pre-run GO, disclosed
void_rule.rulings: recorded with a UTC timestamp before the run they affect

budget.mps: not used; nothing is trained; CPU float32 keeps features bit-reproducible
budget.expected: collection 15-20 min, assembly and checks ~15 min, gate ~5 min; ~2.2 GB corpus + ~2 GB shards

run_command: uv run --no-sync python scripts/collect_apple_look.py run --seeds frozen --output data/apple-look-v1 --work data/apple-look-v1-work

pilot.purpose: check the collector policy still succeeds from the post-look pose; time and storage; not evidence; not in the corpus
pilot.readability: smoke mode: targets replaced by seeded noise; wiring only
pilot.earlier_smoke: outputs/task064-scratch/smoke-a (4 roots, readability skipped), pipeline only

process: PR 1: protocol, manifest, look_corpus.py, tests, task card; merges on a reported APPROVE and green CI
PR 2: collector, readability gate, guard tests, script pins; merges on a reported APPROVE and green CI
gated run starts only on the pre-run reviewer's reported verdict, never on a review file read from disk
PR 3: results document, results manifest (dataset manifest hash), summarize script; a reviewer checks every restated number by script
one task, one agent; post-freeze defects fixed only through a disclosed amendment
not_done: no second encoder, input size, read-out point or look
no hand crop, no overview camera
